approach: One gate-crate predicate attribution::cutover_base(git, commit) (Some(C0) when the commit is C0 or descends from it and the cutover is Shown) drives every writer. Committer::build_commit_in and commit_with_staged (moved onto Committer; Athena delegates) strip Athena-* trailers via a pure strip_athena_trailers in athena-git. Git gets squash_text_relaxed beside the unchanged strict squash_text. The free land_pr no longer takes a precomputed squash text: LandPr.squash becomes `&dyn SquashText`, a small trait in gh.rs with `text_for(&self, commit) -> Result<CommitText>`. It is implemented for Git (strict or relaxed by cutover_base of the commit's parent) and for CommitText (returns a clone, so existing tests' `squash: &text()` compile unchanged). land_pr calls job.squash.text_for(job.commit) just before host.merge; Athena::land_pr passes &self.git. The end-to-end test passes the real Git of the scratch repo, so it runs the production selection. gate() drops only invariant::check for a post-C0 parent. Readers keep trailers up to C0 and gain a C0..head fallback by records path. run.rs::retry_landing is named as a follow-up in the docs.

decisions.choice: Make the free land_pr choose the squash text: LandPr.squash becomes `&'a dyn SquashText`; Git implements it with the cutover choice; CommitText implements it as a fixed text; land_pr calls it with job.commit just before host.merge.
decisions.reason: Finding 2: Athena::land_pr and the end-to-end test now share one code path, and the test passes the scratch repo's Git, so using strict text post-C0 fails it (strict refuses a trailer-free landing commit, or would carry Athena- lines). Impl for CommitText keeps the ~7 existing struct literals compiling unchanged.

rejected.option: Keep a precomputed squash field plus a squash_text_for helper
rejected.why: The test supplies the text itself, so reverting production to strict goes unnoticed.

rejected.option: Build a full Athena in the test
rejected.why: Needs agent/driver wiring unrelated to this behavior.

decisions.choice: Key stripping and relaxed text on cutover state Shown (landing record plus import manifest) through one predicate attribution::cutover_base.
decisions.reason: Same switch check_history uses; no drift between writers, gate and readers; a trailer-free commit during Pending would fail old rules.

rejected.why: History check still uses old rules while Pending.
The repo's own athena.toml names it, so existing tests would lose trailers.

decisions.reason: Needed to strip and to test without a full Athena.

decisions.choice: Strip at the choke points with pure strip_athena_trailers, touching only a final all-trailer paragraph and only Athena- keys.
decisions.reason: Many callers build trailers; one point covers them, and the gate sees the committed message.

decisions.choice: gate() skips only invariant::check for post-C0 parents, in every scope.
decisions.reason: Invariant reads trailers; content and jobs checks do not.

rejected.why: It reads records; dropping it weakens validation.

decisions.choice: Keep readers; add a C0..head fallback by records a job adds (landed_commit, status trace, auditor). Each reader gets its own test whose name contains `trace_and_audit_read_trailers_up_to_c0`.
decisions.reason: Post-C0 commits have no Athena-Job trailer; finding 3 asks for a shared substring so one filter runs all.

rejected.why: Out of scope; pre-C0 history needs them.

decisions.choice: End-to-end test keeps both checks: landing record commits[].sha equals base..head in order, AND the Landing record's commit on the records branch is found, its second parent equals the PR head, and base..that parent is walked asserting no Athena- line on the three commits. The squash commit message (commit_tree from the CommitText that land_pr gave the host; FakeHost.merge records the text it received) is asserted trailer-free.
decisions.reason: Finding 1: restores the accepted criterion wording; the second parent belongs to the records commit (gh.rs: landing record takes head as second parent), not the host squash commit.

decisions.choice: Name run.rs::retry_landing explicitly as a follow-up (it reads Athena-Prediction from the closing commit) in CHANGELOG and D111; no run.rs change.
decisions.reason: Finding 4: run.rs is not a deliverable; docs must not overstate which readers work post-C0.

demonstrations.method: records_flow test: cutover_world(true) lands the cutover job. Build one job branch: an intervention commit (Committer::commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer::commit_records) and the job landing commit (Committer::build_commit) with Athena-Job, Athena-Verified-Content, Athena-Intervention and Co-Authored-By trailers given. Land through the free land_pr with squash: the scratch repo's Git (production text selection), FakeHost recording the text it is asked to merge with; make the squash commit with commit_tree from that text. Read the Landing record on the records branch, take its second parent and assert it equals the PR head, walk base..that parent.
demonstrations.observes: The squash message and each of the three commits (second-parent walk, and commits[].sha equal to base..head in order) have no line starting 'Athena-'; Co-Authored-By survives.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the strip or the relaxed text chosen inside land_pr, commits carry Athena- lines, or strict squash text refuses the trailer-free landing commit.

demonstrations.method: Same scratch repo: read the landing record and call check_history and check_attribution on the post-C0 base. No CLI athena check is added to lifecycle.rs.
demonstrations.observes: Kinds are [declared_intervention, records_only, job_landing] in order; check_history and check_attribution report no violations.
demonstrations.fails_without: Trailer-free commits judged by old rules, or an unrecorded squash, give violations or wrong kinds.

demonstrations.method: athena-git unit tests: strict squash_text unchanged (exactly one Athena-Job, refuses none or two); squash_text_relaxed on a commit with Athena-Job, Athena-Verified-Content, Co-Authored-By and on one with none. gh.rs tests (names contain squash_text) of the SquashText impl for Git with a pre-C0 parent (strict, refuses a trailer-free commit) and a post-C0 parent (relaxed). The end-to-end test in criterion 1 also uses this path through land_pr.
demonstrations.observes: Relaxed body has no Athena- line, keeps Co-Authored-By and prose, and does not error without Athena-Job; the Git impl picks each form by cutover state; land_pr's merge call receives the relaxed text post-C0.
demonstrations.fails_without: A relaxed form that keeps trailers fails the no-Athena- assertion; one requiring Athena-Job errors; land_pr using strict fails the criterion 1 test.

demonstrations.method: Repo A (cutover Shown), B (no cutover_job), C (cutover_job named, no landing record): call commit_records and commit_with_staged with Athena-Job, Athena-Intervention, Co-Authored-By trailers. Then the full cargo test with no existing tests edited.
demonstrations.observes: A: no Athena- line, Co-Authored-By kept. B and C: trailers exactly as given. Existing suite passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: No strip keeps trailers in A; a strip without the cutover check removes them in B and C and breaks existing tests.

demonstrations.method: history.rs cutover_tests: trailer-free post-C0 tip with a content violation, a governed change with no trailer, and a bad job record; a lib.rs test runs gate(Change::of_commit(post), Scope::Commit) on it, with a pre-C0 parent control.
demonstrations.observes: check_history reports no Size, PersonalData, Invariant or jobs violation (only secrets and attribution run) while check_history_with_exempt reports them; gate() reports Size/PersonalData and the jobs violation but no Rule::Invariant; a pre-C0 parent still gets Invariant.
demonstrations.fails_without: If gate kept invariant::check, Invariant appears; if it dropped content or jobs, those violations vanish; if check_history ran content, Size appears.

demonstrations.method: Three tests, one each in status.rs, auditor.rs and gh.rs (landed_commit), all named with the substring trace_and_audit_read_trailers_up_to_c0 so one filter runs them. Each uses a scratch repo with a pre-C0 commit carrying Athena-Job: X and a post-C0 trailer-free commit adding X's records, plus a no-cutover control.
demonstrations.observes: trace lists both commits; read_changed_files reads the files; landed_commit returns the post-C0 commit; the control equals trailer-only results.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the fallback the post-C0 commit is missing and the auditor/landed_commit fail with 'cannot audit job' / 'is not landed on this branch'.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff. CHANGELOG entry and D111 follow-up (job 7 part 1b) state that writers stop after C0, that readers still use trailers up to C0 (legacy history rule, trace, auditor, landed_commit with fallback), that after C0 the history check runs only secrets and attribution while the gate drops only the invariant check, and that run.rs retry_landing still needs trailers (follow-up).
demonstrations.observes: Both files carry the entries and match check_after_cutover in history.rs.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked, then git diff --stat.
demonstrations.observes: All clean; no athena.toml, defaults.toml or ci.yml in the diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any format, lint or test failure, or a governance file in the diff.
